methods.text_en: Only when camera movement is permitted, orbit continuously around the established spatial relationship.
methods.text_zh: 仅在允许机位移动时，用连续环绕保持既有主体与空间关系。

methods.text_en: Observe from an established subjective or low viewpoint without forcing inversion.
methods.text_zh: 从既定主观视角或低机位观察，不强制倒置画面。
